notes: The Claude accounts, models and efforts the picker offers (read by claude-picker and my-pane).
An account is the environment Claude starts with: `unset` removes variables (fish exports ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which wins over a login), `env` sets them ("~/" is that machine's home).
A separate login lives in its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. ~/.claude-personal links settings, skills, plugins, rules and projects to ~/.claude, so only the login differs.
`plain`: what a `claude` started outside the picker runs as. Model/effort value "" = Claude's default (no flag; /model default, /effort auto live).
